events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktrees, branches and coordination log
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git worktree list | head -20; git branch -a --list '*t300*' '*t-299*' '*t299*'; git log --oneline -3 origin/main; grep -nE 'T-300|T-299|T-272|T-264' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-299 merge state and hit counts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/t-299-vendor-inboxes origin/main && echo merged || echo notmerged; git rev-parse --short origin/t-299-vendor-inboxes main; git log --oneline origin/main..main | wc -l; git log --oneline main..origin/main | wc -l; for n in godaddy 'microsoft 365' m365 instantly sendgrid zerobounce neverbounce builtwith heyreach calendly apollo; do echo "$n: $(git grep -il "$n" origin/t-299-vendor-inboxes -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/survey.html | wc -l)"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create worktree from T-299 and merge main
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git worktree add -q -b t300-ruled-out-cleanup /private/tmp/wt-t300 origin/t-299-vendor-inboxes 2>&1|tail -2; cd /private/tmp/wt-t300; git log --oneline HEAD..main | wc -l; git merge --no-edit -q main 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: List conflict counts
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; for f in cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts cloud/src/jobs-day2.ts cloud/src/jobs-tantra.ts cloud/src/jobs.ts docs/onboarding-v3/coverage.json; do echo "$f $(grep -c '^<<<<<<<' $f)"; done; git log --oneline -1 main -- cloud/src/jobs-m365.ts; git diff origin/t-299-vendor-inboxes...main --stat -- cloud/src/jobs-m365.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count conflict hunks and lines per file
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300; for f in $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U); do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f $(grep -c '^<<<<<<<' $f) $(awk '/^<<<<<<</{s=NR}/^>>>>>>>/{t+=NR-s}END{print t}' $f)"; done
